text_normalization.location: client preprocessing, excluded from engine timings

method.transport: loopback HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, one connection per worker process
method.load: same closed-loop driver; fixed duration; warmup before every run; HTTP send through response read, excluding JSON decode
method.quality: same qrels and ranking_metrics; top 100 for relevance; top 10 for latency
method.search: default ranking rules, typo tolerance, prefix search and automatic language detection; proximityPrecision recorded in settings; matchingStrategy=last; estimatedTotalHits capped by default maxTotalHits, unlike SeekPower exact count=true OR search
method.indexing: 500 documents per request; wait for every task in each 100-request group; includes asynchronous indexing completion and polling, not just HTTP acceptance
method.storage: same original body and t2s search_body; only search_body searchable; record_id and original body returned. Meilisearch also stores search_body internally
method.memory: RSS includes resident mapped pages; indexing-memory budget is not an RSS hard limit
method.scope: full lexical corpus; no embeddings, tuning on dev labels, cold-cache or saturation claims
